title: Client typecheck gates + crate dep-edge hygiene (arch item L)
description: The gui and excel `typecheck:e2e` and `typecheck:test` scripts are wired into the t2 landing gate so a client type error fails the gate, and the two dev-dependency back-edges (celnet-proto → celnet-core, celnet-surface → celnet-crypto-vanilla) are removed so the crate graph stays strictly one-way. This is the frozen-contract acceptance for the deliverable 'typecheck-and-dep-gates'.

assertions.statement: celnet-surface has no dependency/USAGE edge into celnet-crypto-vanilla — the crypto-vanilla leaf depends on surface, never the reverse; the dev-dep back-edge is removed (the graph shows zero celnet-surface → celnet-crypto-vanilla edges).

celnet-proto carries no dev-dependency cycle back into celnet-core; proto's only celnet-core coupling is the one-way production conversion (celnet_core::compare tolerances), verified by `cargo tree` / cargo-machete rather than a test-only back-edge.

The gui + excel `typecheck:e2e` and `typecheck:test` scripts (tsc over the e2e and unit TypeScript, e.g. the EdgeClient wire client) are wired into the t2 landing gate, so a client-side type error fails t2.
